description: Contract for the public upstream fixture used to validate a new CryoAtom2 install. Public data only (EMD-33198 / PDB 7XHT). Values are upstream facts, not host facts; timings depend on the GPU and must not be quoted as a guarantee.

fixture.name: EMD-33198 / 7XHT
fixture.content: one protein chain of 496 aa, one RNA record, two DNA records; map approximately 131 MB

pass_criteria.note_running_time_log: CryoAtom2 2.1.1 does NOT write running_time.log (the call is commented out in build.py). The copy inside the fixture archive is upstream's shipped reference output. Its absence after a run is normal.
pass_criteria.confidence_column: B_iso_or_equiv carries model confidence, not an experimental B-factor

reference_timing.note: The value in the running_time.log that ships inside upstream's fixture archive, measured on upstream's hardware. A first run adds cold model loading. Time your own runs; do not present this as an expected runtime for a real map.

on_failure: no mmCIF: the install is not ready — do not proceed to user data
segfault in stage 1: getp was not compiled for this host
missing weight error: stage the cache and re-verify
CUDA OOM on this small fixture: the GPU or its VRAM allocation is wrong, not the map
